# Third-party OCR components

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js — Apache-2.0, see TESSERACT-LICENSE.md.
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core — Apache-2.0, see core/LICENSE.
- Simplified Chinese and English traineddata, 4.0.0_best_int distributions — https://github.com/naptha/tessdata — Apache-2.0; distributed through https://www.npmjs.com/org/tesseract.js-data. See lang/LICENSE.

The application serves all recognition assets from its own origin. No bill images are sent to these upstream projects.
